import json
text = "# Setup\n```sh\n# install deps\n```\n## Run"
D = 'def L: "# Setup\\n```sh\\n# install deps\\n```\\n## Run" | split("\\n"); def off($n): [L | .[:$n - 1][] | length + 1] | add // 0; '
N = '.opened.json.sections.notebook'
O = '.outline.json.sections.notebook'
check = {
  "format": 1,
  "rule": "req~heading-outline.fenced-code~1",
  "example": "a shell comment in a code block",
  "files": {"setup.md": text},
  "steps": [
    {"line": "* Given a notebook whose line 1 is \"# Setup\", whose lines 2 to 4 are a fenced code block holding the line \"# install deps\", and whose line 5 is \"## Run\"",
     "do": [{"launch": {"build": "debug", "inspector": True}},
            {"drive": ["menu", "File > Open…"]},
            {"drive": ["choose", {"file": "setup.md"}]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "opened"}],
     "expect": [
       {"that": D + N + '.length == (L | join("\\n") | length)', "why": "palantir has the notebook open, its whole text"},
       {"that": N + '.folded == []', "why": "nothing is folded before the outline is read"}]},
    {"line": "* When palantir reads its outline",
     "do": [{"drive": ["menu", "View > Fold All"]},
            {"inspect": ["wait"]},
            {"inspect": ["state"], "as": "outline"}],
     "expect": []},
    {"line": "* Then its only headings are on lines 1 and 5",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [
       {"that": D + 'any(' + O + '.folded[]; .offset == off(1) and (.line | rtrimstr("\\n")) == L[0])', "why": "line 1, \"# Setup\", is a heading: Fold All folds it"},
       {"that": D + 'any(' + O + '.folded[]; .offset == off(5) and (.line | rtrimstr("\\n")) == L[4])', "why": "line 5, \"## Run\", after the code block, is a heading: Fold All folds it"},
       {"that": D + 'all(' + O + '.folded[]; .offset == off(1) or .offset == off(5))', "why": "no other line is a heading, not \"# install deps\" on line 3 inside the code block"}]},
    {"line": "* And \"# Setup\" owns lines 2 to 5",
     "do": [],
     "expect": [
       {"that": D + 'any(' + O + '.folded[]; .offset == off(1)) and [' + O + '.drawn[].offset] == [off(1)]', "why": "with \"# Setup\" folded the window shows line 1 and hides lines 2 to 5"}]}
  ]
}
open("work/check.json", "w").write(json.dumps(check, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
EOF
